name: Indutrade AB
sector: Industrials / technical trading and niche industrial companies
businessSummary: Acquisitive group of about 200 niche technology and industrial companies in five business areas (Flow Technology, Industrial & Engineering, Process Energy & Water, Life Science, Infrastructure & Safety), mostly Europe.

netDebt.period: balance sheet, date not stated (likely 30 Jun 2026)
netDebt.note: Aggregator figure, probably includes IFRS 16 leases and pension. Company-reported interest-bearing net debt at 31 Dec 2025 was 7,556 (ND/EBITDA 1.4x). Q3 2026 net debt not read (report page lacked it).

enterpriseValue.note: Stockanalysis EV 103,210 at its Oct 1 price.

peTrailing.note: Stockanalysis 34.96 at 255.80. Reported EPS FY2025 7.03; Q3 2026 EPS 2.21 (1.85).

peForward.note: Computed on 255.80 price; at 268.20 about 28.6 if EPS estimate unchanged (derived).

evEbitTrailing.source: derived: EV 107,208 / TTM EBIT 4,003 (stockanalysis, to 30 Jun 2026)
evEbitTrailing.note: Operating profit is EBIT after acquisition amortisation (EBITA is higher). Stockanalysis shows 25.78 at older price. Agent evToEbit null.

fcfTTM.note: Operating cash flow 4,131 less capex 464, before lease payments and acquisitions. Company 'free operating cash flow' FY2025 3,500.

netDebtToEbitda.note: Agent figure; company reported 1.4x at 31 Dec 2025 (net debt 7,556), 1.8x at 2022 year-end. Lease treatment of agent figure unverified. Rising from 1.4x with acquisition pace.

roic.note: Company reports ROCE not ROIC. ROCE 23% (2022), 21% (2023), 19% (2024), 18% (2025); target at least 20%. Stockanalysis ROIC 11.52% (different definition).

organicGrowthQ3_2026.note: Total sales +13%; acquisitions contributed about 8 points (period of the 8% unclear). Order intake +16%, organic +6%.

ebitaMarginQ3_2026.note: EBITA 1,358 (1,143), margin 14.6% a year earlier. Consensus (FactSet, 10 est.) EBITA 1,345 per Placera 2026-10-21; slight beat.

sectorMetrics.targets: Margin target >=14% EBITA (FY2025 13.8%, missed); ROCE >=20% (18%, missed); growth >=10% p.a.; net debt/equity <=100% (44%).

recentEvents: Q3 2026 (23 Oct 2026): sales 8,871 (+13%, organic +5%), EBITA 1,358 (+19%), margin 15.3%, EPS 2.21, OCF 1,216; all five business areas grew organically.
13 acquisitions signed YTD with annual sales of 2.1bn; Euromed/Sinmed and Schraner announced after quarter-end.
Broker target raises in Sep-Oct 2026 (SEB 288, Handelsbanken 290, Goldman 211 to 261) per MarketScreener.
valueTrapFlags: Margin and ROCE below company targets in FY2025 (13.8% vs 14%, 18% vs 20%) and ROCE has fallen four years running (23% to 18%); Q3 2026 margin 15.3% shows recovery but one quarter.
Growth is mostly acquired: Q3 total +13% vs organic +5%; FY2025 organic -2%.
Net debt/EBITDA up (agent 1.69x vs 1.4x at YE2025) as acquisitions continue.
Trailing P/E about 35 and EV/EBIT about 27 leave little room for a miss (valuation context only).

valuation.method: Next-12m EPS x justified P/E. Basis 2026E EPS 8.0 (TTM 7.36, Q3 EPS 2.21, recovery under way; lead estimate). Historical multiple ranges not verified by agents; justified multiples are lead estimates.

bear.note: Industrial demand stalls, margin stays near 12%. Justified multiple 22x on next-12m 8.32.

base.note: Organic about 4% plus acquisitions, EBITA margin back toward 14%. Justified multiple 28x on next-12m 8.72.

bull.note: Margin recovery to target and strong M&A year. Justified multiple 32x on next-12m 8.96.

valuation.whyItFits: Decentralised technical-trading acquirer; Q3 2026 organic +5% across all five areas suggests the 2024-25 margin slide is reversing.
valuation.growthDrivers: Organic recovery, 13 acquisitions YTD (SEK 2.1bn sales), margin return toward the 14% target.
valuation.saturation: P/E 35 on depressed earnings: recovery already priced; brokers lifted targets in Sep-Oct (analyst opinion).
valuation.principalRisk: Margins and ROCE stayed below targets in FY2025; a renewed industrial slowdown would leave a 35x multiple unsupported.
